'''Xinishia''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Tarasin]], who was a member of the [[Wyrd]], a group of [[The Force/Legends|Force]] witches who operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Xinishia was one of the [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenants]] of [[Liriana]], the leader of the [[Wyrd]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Liriana traveled off-[[Planet/Legends|planet]], so Xinishia used her leader's absence as an opportunity to try and make herself leader of the Wyrd. She discovered a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] artifact that enhanced her Force powers and planned to use it to cause [[Cloud Mountain]], an inert volcano, to erupt and destroy the village [[Kiirloor]]. However, the [[heroes of Cularin]] attempted to stop her.
